elements.content: Communication Goal: I can ask for and give simple directions.

- Level: A1 General English

- Focus: How Can I Get to the Hotel
- Materials: vocabulary cards, audio, reading handout
Warm-up: say one word you already know for this topic.

Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

hotel — a building where travellers sleep. Example: The hotel is near the station.
turn left — to go to the left side. Example: Turn left at the corner.
turn right — to go to the right side. Example: Turn right after the bank.
go straight — to continue without turning. Example: Go straight for two hundred metres.
corner — the place where two streets meet. Example: The bus stop is on the corner.
traffic lights — the red, amber and green signals. Example: Stop at the traffic lights.
bus stop — the place where a bus picks you up. Example: The bus stop is near the hotel.
map — a drawing of streets or a country. Example: Look at the map, please.
near — close to. Example: The shop is near my house.
far — not near. Example: The station is not far.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• How can I get to ...?
• Go straight.
• Turn left at the corner.
• It is near the ...
• Is it far?
Vocabulary practice: choose the correct word.
Which word means 'a building where travellers sleep'?
Which word means 'to go to the left side'?
Complete the sentence with a word from the list.

elements.placeholder: Complete: The ___ is near the station.

elements.content: Stress the direction word.
Turn LEFT. Go STRAIGHT.
Listen and repeat three times.
Which word carries the main stress?
Grammar focus: Imperatives for directions.
Use the imperative for directions: Turn left. Go straight. Take the second street. Add please to be polite: Turn left, please.
Controlled practice: choose the correct option.
Choose the correct direction.
Which word means 'not near'?
Complete the sentence.
Reading: read the text and answer the questions.
The hotel is near the station. Go straight and turn right at the traffic lights. The bus stop is on the corner. It is not far.
Listening: listen to the dialogue and answer the questions.
A: How can I get to the hotel? B: Go straight, then turn left at the corner. A: Is it far? B: No, it is near the bus stop.
